name: mobile-app-config
description: Configure mobile app projects and export Figma Variables JSON into Flutter design-system Dart files from agent workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Configure mobile apps and export Figma Variables to Flutter
interface.longDescription: Deterministic mobile app setup workflows for Android product flavors, Firebase google-services.json files, package names, flavor-specific app names, generated assets, optional network security, and Figma Variables JSON to Flutter design-system Dart exports.
defaultPrompt: Use Mobile App Config to configure dev and prod Android flavors.
Use Mobile App Config to configure Firebase for Android flavors.
Use Mobile App Config to generate Android app assets.
Use Mobile App Config to configure dev-only network security.
Use Mobile App Config to export Figma Variables JSON into Flutter design-system Dart files.
